_readme: Design session for the Shards of Infinity fan port — game content is NOT touched by this file.
Reopen it with Tools/CardDesigner/index.html (Open…) to keep designing.
cards.added = complete new card specs. cards.modified = per-field was -> now deltas vs the live pool.
cards.removed = cards this design cuts. keywords.* = same idea for mechanic keywords.
qty = copies in the center deck (starters: copies per player). cost null = the card is not bought.
To implement: follow the checklist in the exported Markdown brief (Export AI brief button).

session.name: Duel of Doom
session.notes: Claude pass on top of the 2026-07-23 session: hero abilities separated from Focus (both usable in the same turn), Allegiance conversions (Ferrata Guard / Mainframe Abbot / Hounds of Volos / The Lost), Allegiance + Scry keywords, Dominion reworked (3+ other cards of 3+ different factions), and 15 SUGGESTED cards — 3 per faction, rationale in each card's notes.

added.name: Star Seeker
added.text:
Exhaust: Warp ∞.

M20: Warp ∞ a second time.
added.artPrompt: a radiant navigator's astrolabe orbited by streaking comets and folded space, threads of teleport light converging on a single crimson star, cosmic void background

added.name: Praetorian-03
added.text:
Gain 1 mastery and draw a card.
M15: 2 mastery and 2 cards instead.
M25: 3 mastery and 3 cards instead.
added.artPrompt: an ancient relic warframe helm crowned with a halo of data-glyphs, blue energy conduits, kneeling in a shrine of light, ceremonial and imposing

added.name: Multitask Brain
added.text:
For each different faction you played this turn, gain 2 power and draw a card. (M20: gain 4 power instead of 2.)

Dominion: gain 3 mastery.
added.artPrompt: a floating multi-lobed cybernetic brain wired into five glowing processor cores of different colors, streams of parallel thought, sterile laboratory light

added.name: Doom Gate
added.text:
You are unaffected by Ingeminex attacks.

When you play this champion, shuffle 20 new Ingeminex into the center deck (once per game).

Exhaust: destroy an Ingeminex.
added.artPrompt: a towering obsidian gateway wreathed in violet void-fire, monstrous silhouettes pressing against a rippling portal, ominous and vast, dark cathedral of ruin

added.name: Unknown God
added.text:
M20: your Exhaust effects apply their effects twice.

Exhaust: gain 5 health for each champion you control.
added.artPrompt: a colossal faceless deity of living wood and crystal rising from an overgrown temple, countless roots and vines, radiant green life-energy, awe and mystery

added.name: Testudo Vanguard
added.text:
Your shields are also applied to each of your champions individually.

Exhaust: gain 2 gems.
added.artPrompt: a legionnaire locking tower shields into a glowing testudo wall
added.notes: SUGGESTION — the champion-protection card: a board-only Zetta (protects champions, never your face, so no turtling). Reuses the taunt split machinery.

added.name: Century Forge
added.text: Shield 3. Gain 3 gems. Inspire: the next champion you recruit this turn enters play directly.
added.artPrompt: a forge-hall stamping out armored soldiers on a conveyor of sparks
added.notes: SUGGESTION — generalizes Numeri Drones' deploy-directly tech to ANY champion, matching the Evokatus/Primus all-champions errata direction.

added.name: Riposte Doctrine
added.text: Gain 3 power. If you played or revealed a shield from your hand, gain 6 power instead.
added.artPrompt: a battered duelist turning a parry into a counter-thrust, banner torn
added.notes: SUGGESTION — duel comeback lever aimed at the persistent-health-lead problem (a +10 health lead wins ~87% at DIAMOND).

added.name: Index of Futures
added.text: Shield 2. Draw a card. Look at the center deck's top 3 cards; put them back in any order.
added.artPrompt: a librarian monk leafing through a floating card catalogue of tomorrows
added.notes: SUGGESTION — turns the pay-2 row-removal rule (and Warp / Shard Defiant / Rez's Scry) from a gamble into informed planning.

added.name: Bulwark Chanter
added.text: Shield 4. Gain 2 gems. Dominion: gain 2 mastery and draw a card.
added.artPrompt: an armored cantor whose hymn raises a rampart of translucent glyphs
added.notes: SUGGESTION — a shield-bodied payoff for the reworked Dominion (only Giga / Omnius / Order Initiate carry it in the shop today).

added.name: Aegis Archivist
added.text: Exhaust: gain 2 gems. (Dominion: gain 5 gems instead.)
added.artPrompt: a curator of glowing bucklers filed like books, one drawn half-open
added.notes: SUGGESTION — first shield-payoff card (shields really prevent 14.4% of damage): revealing leaks your defense info for tempo — a read tradeoff.

added.name: Thornshell Warden
added.text: Exhaust: gain 2 health. If you are at 50 health, also gain 2 power.
added.artPrompt: a turtle-shelled forest guardian curled behind interlocking bark plates
added.notes: SUGGESTION — a cheap high-defense wall: champion protection by being unprofitable to kill; feeds the full-health theme.

added.name: Nectar Alchemist
added.text: Gain 4 health. This turn, health you would gain beyond the 50 cap becomes power instead.
added.artPrompt: a druid distilling overflowing golden sap into a blade-shaped vial
added.notes: SUGGESTION — fixes dead at-cap heals (a mini Entropic Talons for everyone): heal decks stop stalling and start threatening.

added.name: Lifebloom Ritual
added.text:
Until end of turn, all healing you receive is doubled.

Unify: gain 4 health.
added.artPrompt: a fallen colossus re-sprouting from a ring of luminous flowers
added.notes: SUGGESTION — Undergrowth champion recursion with a Unify kicker: regrowth flavor, board-based counterplay to champion removal.

added.name: Whisper Extractor
added.text:
Gain 2 power.
Target opponent draws a card, then choose a card in their hand — they discard it.
added.artPrompt: a shade pulling a single glowing card from a fanned hand of shadows
added.notes: SUGGESTION — the intel strike (your spec): snipe one strategic card (an Infinity Shard before the M30 turn, a key shield) but they redraw, so it never strips a hand. IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-25 with the redraw made explicit and mandatory (the first build omitted it and played too strong).

added.name: Doomstalker
added.text: Gain 5 power. If an Ingeminex is in play, gain 8 instead.
added.artPrompt: a void hunter stalking a titanic silhouette across a broken plain
added.notes: SUGGESTION — rides Doom Gate's Ingeminex flood + the base ItH monsters: monster pressure becomes a deliberate plan.

added.name: Bleak Communion
added.text: Lose 4 health (not damage). Draw two cards. Echo: an opponent loses that health instead of you.
added.artPrompt: cultists sharing a chalice of black light, veins glowing
added.notes: SUGGESTION — Wraethe finally pays life for draw (Oblivion Gatekeeper's cost language); Echo rewards faction commitment. Data Heretic moving to cost 4 leaves room at 3.

added.name: Comet
added.text:
Destroy target opponent.

This card cannot be fast-played and must be bought using gems.

This card cannot be banished from the shop.
added.artPrompt: a crimson comet-rider streaking low over a row of market stalls

added.name: Prism
added.text: Shield 2. Draw a card. This card counts as a card of every faction.
added.artPrompt: a faceted crystal wanderer refracting five colors of light
added.notes: SUGGESTION — the wildcard glue: enables Unify and the reworked Dominion in any deck (Project Yggdrasil's counts-as tech).

added.name: Grim Tutor
added.text:
Search your draw pile for a card and put it into your hand, then shuffle.
You lose 3 health.
added.artPrompt: a gaunt black-robed sage tracing a pact in blood over a floating open grimoire, skulls and candle smoke, sickly green light
added.notes: User request 2026-07-24 — MTG Grim Tutor homage; Mercenary per user decision (rent-a-tutor fast-play option).

added.name: Longshot
added.text: Reveal the top 2 cards of the center deck. You may fast-play any of them that are allies costing 3 or less; put the rest on the bottom of the center deck. (M15: cost 5 or less instead.)
added.artPrompt: a red-cloaked gambler flipping the top card of an endless deck
added.notes: SUGGESTION — makes the center-deck top a strategic zone alongside Rez's Scry and Index of Futures: an informed gamble that improves with information.

text.was: Shield 2. Gain 2 power. Return a champion from your discard pile to your hand.
text.now: Shield 2. Gain 3 power. Return a champion from your discard pile to your hand.

text.was: Gain 3 gems.
text.now:
Choose one:
- Gain 3 gems
- Gain 5 gems, banish this card at the end of your turn.

text.was: Gain 4 health and draw a card. If you are at 50 health, gain 6 power.
text.now: Gain 4 health and draw a card. If you are at 50 health, gain 4 power.

text.was: Gain 2 power and draw a card. Unify: gain 6 health.
text.now: Gain 2 power and draw a card. Unify: gain 4 health.

text.was: Gain 3 health. Unify: also gain 5 power.
text.now: Gain 3 health. Unify: also gain 4 power.

text.was: Shield 5. Gain 2 gems.
text.now: Shield 5. Gain 3 gems.

text.was: Gain 2 gems. Dominion: gain 2 mastery.
text.now:
You may remove a card from the shop.
Gain 2 gems. Dominion: gain 2 mastery.

text.was: Gain 2 power. Echo: gain 6 instead.
text.now: Gain 2 power. Echo: gain 5 instead.

text.was: When played, draw a card. Exhaust: gain 1 power per Homodeus champion you control.
text.now: When played, draw a card. Exhaust: gain 1 power per champion you control.

text.was: Exhaust: if you control three or more Homodeus champions, draw two cards.
text.now: Exhaust: if you control three or more champions, draw two cards.

text.was: Can't be attacked with power (card effects can still destroy it). Exhaust: gain 1 power.
text.now: Can't be attacked with power (card effects can still destroy it). Exhaust: gain 2 power.

text.was: Gain 10 health. Unify: gain 10 power.
text.now: Gain 8 health. Unify: gain 8 power.

text.was: Gain 4 health.
text.now: Gain 3 health. Unify: gain 6 health instead.

text.was: Gain 5 power.
text.now: Gain 4 power.

text.was: Shield 3. Draw a card. If your character is Tetra, gain 1 mastery.
text.now: Shield 3. Draw a card. Allegiance Order 3: gain 1 mastery.

text.was: If your character is Decima, your champions get +2 defense. Exhaust: gain 1 gem per Homodeus champion you control.
text.now: Allegiance Homodeus 3: your champions get +2 defense. Exhaust: gain 1 gem per Homodeus champion you control.

text.was: Exhaust: gain 4 power. M10: your damage ignores shields this turn.
text.now: Exhaust: gain 3 power. M10: your damage ignores shields this turn.

text.was: Gain 5 health. If your character is Volos, also gain 5 power.
text.now: Gain 5 health. Allegiance Undergrowth 3: also gain 5 power.

text.was: Gain 6 power. If your character is Ko Syn Wu, you may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.
text.now: Gain 5 power. Allegiance Wraethe 3: you may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.

text.was: Relic champion, defense 9. While in play: shield 3 (M20: 6). Its shield never works from hand.
text.now:
While in play: shield 3 (M20: 6).

Exhaust, pay 3 gems: until your next turn, your shields are doubled. (Killing this champion does not remove this effect.)

text.was: Shield equal to your mastery. Draw a card. M20: draw two instead.
text.now:
Shield equal to your mastery. Draw two cards.

M20: While this card is in your discard pile, gain Shield equal to half your mastery (rounded up).

text.was: Gain 1 mastery, then power equal to half your mastery (rounded up). M20: equal to your full mastery.
text.now: Gain 2 mastery, then power equal to half your mastery (rounded up). M20: equal to your full mastery.

text.was: Gain 5 power (M20: 10). If you deal 10+ unprevented damage to one opponent this turn, draw 3 extra cards at end of turn.
text.now: Gain 6 power (M20: 10). If you deal 10+ unprevented damage to one opponent this turn, draw 3 extra cards at end of turn.

text.was: Gain 2 mastery. Return a mercenary from your discard pile to your hand. M20: return ALL of them.
text.now: Gain 2 mastery. Return a mercenary from your discard or draw pile to your hand. M20: return ALL of them.

text.was: Shield 2. You may put an Aion card from your discard pile on top of your deck. Draw a card.
text.now:
Shield 2. You may put an Aion card from your discard pile on top of your deck. (M10: any card instead.)

Draw a card.

text.was: Exhaust: gain 2 gems and 2 power. If your character is Rez, you may keep cards you fast-play (they join your discard).
text.now:
Exhaust: gain 2 gems and 2 power.

M10: you may keep cards you fast-play (they join your discard).

text.was: Gain 1 mastery and draw a card. M20: take an extra turn (once per game).
text.now: Gain 2 mastery and draw two cards. M20: take an extra turn (once per game).

text.was: Gain 3 gems and 3 power. M20: banish up to 3 allies from your hand/discard and gain their effects.
text.now:
You may banish a card from your hand or discard pile to gain its effect. (M20: up to 3 cards instead.)

Gain 3 gems and 3 power for each card you banished this turn.

text.was: Gain 2 gems. You may reveal your deck's top 3 cards: up to one revealed champion to your hand, the rest to your discard pile.
text.now: Gain 2 gems. You may reveal your deck's top 5 cards: up to one revealed champion to your hand, the rest to your discard pile.

text.was: Gain 1 mastery. Every player reveals their deck's top card; copy the effect of one revealed ally.
text.now:
Gain 1 mastery. Every player reveals their deck's top card; copy the effect of one revealed ally.
(M20: you may copy any number of effects from the revealed cards instead)

text.was: Exhaust: gain 7 health; then, if you are at 50 health, gain 1 mastery.
text.now: Exhaust: gain 6 health; then, if you are at 50 health, gain 1 mastery.

text.was: Exhaust — Warp 3. M15: Warp 5 instead.
text.now: Exhaust — Warp 3. M15: Warp 6 instead.

text.was: Gain 5 power and 1 mastery.
text.now: Gain 4 power and 1 mastery.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played cards of 3+ different factions this turn, gain 4 power.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played cards of 3+ different factions this turn, gain 5 power.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played 2+ Order allies this turn, gain 2 gems.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played 2+ Order allies this turn, gain 1 gem and 1 mastery.

text.was: Exhaust: fast-play a cost-1 ally from the row for free (you keep it). M20: cost 2 or less.
text.now: Exhaust: fast-play a cost-2 or less ally from the row for free (you may keep it). M20: cost 4 or less.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played a champion this turn, gain 4 health.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played a champion this turn, gain 5 health.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played an Order card and a Wraethe card this turn, gain 1 mastery.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played an Order card and a Wraethe card this turn, gain 1 gem and 1 mastery.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played cards of 3+ different factions this turn, gain 5 health.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played cards of 3+ different factions this turn, gain 7 health.

text.was: Exhaust: if you played 2+ mercenaries this turn, gain 2 gems.
text.now: Exhaust: if you played 2+ mercenaries this turn, gain 3 gems.

text.was: Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).
text.now:
Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).

Recruiting — M5 passive: the first card you buy each turn costs 1 less.

text.was: Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).
text.now:
Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).

Perception — M5, once per turn: pay 3 gems, draw a card.

text.was: Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).
text.now:
Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).

First Aid — M5, once per turn: pay 1 gem, gain 3 health.

text.was: Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).
text.now:
Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).

Sacrifice — M5, once per turn: pay 3 gems and 3 health, banish a card from your hand or discard pile.

text.was: Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).
text.now:
Focus — Exhaust: pay 1 gem, gain 1 mastery (once per turn).

Futureproof — M5, once per turn: pay 1 gem, Scry 2 the center deck.

added.name: Allegiance
added.meaning: Allegiance <Faction> N: active if you own at least N cards of that faction (deck, hand, discard pile and in play — banished and set-aside cards don't count; this card counts itself). Checked when the card is played or exhausted.

added.name: Scry
added.meaning: Scry N: look at the top N cards of that deck; put any number on its bottom and the rest back on top in any order.

meaning.was: Active if you played or revealed a Homodeus, an Undergrowth and a Wraethe card this turn.
meaning.now: Active if you played or revealed at least 3 other cards of at least 3 different factions this turn.
